stories.headline: Law Schools Outlaw AI Amid Fears of Stunted Academic Growth
stories.body: Law schools in the United States have begun banning artificial intelligence in the classroom, according to a Financial Times column Monday (Sept. 7) by Patti Waldmeir. The University of Chicago Law School is among the institutions imposing these restrictions. For the new academic year, phones, tablets and laptops will be forbidden in core first-year classrooms,
